$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/complaints.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office (customer service logs, quality triages and follows up) writes complaints through apps/factory-api's modules/quality/complaints (B-W2a-65), always through command(); the API keeps staff to the companies and parties their grants reach. The floor reads nothing here. W2b schema wave 23 (B-W2b-192's need): a portal or link session (factory_partner_runtime) reads its own party's complaints, without the triage (category, severity, when and by whom), the owner, the safety alert, the findings and root cause (W2b wave 11/16, both @internal), the answer letter while it is written (template, words, files: the customer reads the letter sent, a shared file), the internal note and who answered or wrote a row; it inserts nothing (the API logs a customer's complaint as the person or the tenant's system). Never deleted: a complaint is closed with its reason; a SAFETY complaint closes only with its PPE register entry (the …_sales_w2a_guards triggers). After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Complaint.about: The office logs a complaint (numbered), triages it (category, severity, owner, answer due), raises and acknowledges its safety alert, links it to its order, shipment, return and garment, answers and closes it. W2b (schema wave 23): a portal or link session reads its own party's complaints (what it reported, the state, the answer due and when it was answered), never the triage, the owner, the safety alert, the investigation, the letter being written, the internal note or who wrote it.
